name: Pedro Espíndula
whoAmI: Staff Site Reliability Engineer with 5+ years making production platforms reliable, observable and cost-efficient, mostly at Brazilian fintechs. At Cora I rolled out company-wide alerting and on-call with Rootly, raising alert acknowledgement from 17% to 85%, and consolidated observability onto Datadog, saving $67K a year. At Pagar.me (Stone Co.) I cut MTTA by 70% and MTTR by 55%. Hands-on with Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, AWS, Go and Python.

Owning the reliability and observability roadmap across engineering, building on the Datadog consolidation and Rootly migration
Cut observability costs by $67K a year by consolidating the stack onto Datadog, retiring New Relic and Sentry, and resizing both the contract and data ingestion
